t: Compact delayed fill valve. Can easily change between bottom and side-entry, or 1/2" and 3/8" shank to fit all types of cistern. Height adjustable to meet different water levels, and maintains consistent flush volume under different water pressures. Optional filter and flow restrictor for dirty water and high pressure areas. Brass shank. Easy to install.
b: Suitable for High & Low Pressure Systems
Compatible with All Types of Cistern
